LESSON: COLLAGE MAKING

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 1.6: Collage MAKING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Collage MAKING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. make collage pictures using locally available materials for aesthetics
2. make collage pictures using locally available materials for enjoyment
3. appreciate their own and other pupils work and develop self- esteem. work. safely and neatly Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. make collage pictures using locally available materials for aesthetics
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to make collage pictures using locally available materials for aesthetics. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. make collage pictures using locally available materials for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to make collage pictures using locally available materials for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate their own and other pupils work and develop self- esteem. work. safely and neatly Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate their own and other pupils work and develop self- esteem. work. safely and neatly Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Collage MAKING.
2. Explain Collage MAKING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Collage MAKING.
4. Show that you can: make collage pictures using locally available materials for aesthetics
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Collage MAKING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Collage MAKING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. make collage pictures using locally available materials for aesthetics
2. make collage pictures using locally available materials for enjoyment
3. appreciate their own and other pupils work and develop self- esteem. work. safely and neatly Core-Competence

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
